how: We read the website of every Boston wedding florist listed on Lazo (255 listings, 201 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: same-day delivery shops and gift boutiques, a flower farm stand, a floral preservation studio, a garden designer, and venues listed as florists. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What is in season in New England for my month, and what has to be shipped in for a May or an October wedding?
Do you install and tear down at the venue, and are the strike fee and the late-night pickup in the quote?
Can I see a full wedding's flowers at my budget, not just a bouquet shot?

picks.name: Blush and Bloom Floral Design INC.
picks.blurb: Blush and Bloom is a mother-daughter wedding floral team in Melrose that values transparency and educating couples on exactly what will be designed for the day. Full-service from the first consultation to the final installation, for Boston and the greater New England area.

picks.name: Fleur Soiree
picks.blurb: Terri Daniel of Fleur Soiree has never not been surrounded by flowers, and brings decades of experience to bespoke wedding florals and event design in Newport. The site frames each design as starting with the couple's own vision.

picks.name: Wedding Flowers by Nichole
picks.blurb: Nichole graduated from Bristol Aggie with a floriculture degree in 1998, and her family bought Bourne Florist in 2000. Wedding Flowers by Nichole has now served Cape Cod couples for over 25 years, and asks that you leave the consult sure she understood your vision.

picks.name: Stems in Style
picks.blurb: Kelly of Stems in Style worked in flower shops from high school through college, took an accounting job, and left it within a year for floral design. The Braintree studio publishes what couples actually spent with it in 2024 and 2025 as a starting point, and every proposal is custom.

picks.name: Floristika Studio
picks.blurb: Floristika Studio is a full-service European floral and wedding design studio in Newton serving Boston and New England, with an online boutique on the side. The team puts a strong emphasis on continuing education and sharpening its professional skills.

picks.name: J.Smith Wedding Floral Design
picks.blurb: J.Smith Floral Design is Jenn's full-service wedding and event studio in Buzzards Bay, working from Cape Cod to the South Shore and Boston. The pitch is an artistic eye and a high standard for quality on life's most important events.

picks.name: Greenlion
picks.blurb: Greenlion is Christopher and Kim's Newport studio at the intersection of fine art and floristry. Chris, with a background in horticulture and music, heads up installations and custom builds, while Kim is a self-taught floral designer, gardener and stylist, and they grow flowers and plants themselves.

picks.name: Lupine Flower Company
picks.blurb: Lindsey started Lupine Flower Company in 2020 and has run it from the Rockies to the East Coast, doing everything from washing buckets and retail to weddings and growing her own blooms. Now a floral design and special events florist in the Cambridge and Somerville area.

picks.name: Foxgloves and Ferns
picks.blurb: A woman-owned, full-service wedding and event floral studio in Hanover that has arranged flowers for over 300 weddings since 2012. Foxgloves and Ferns serves Boston, Cape Cod and Nantucket and describes its work as unique and romantic.

picks.name: Berry Branch Floral
picks.blurb: Berry Branch began serving clients in 2018 and opened a brick-and-mortar studio in Somerville in late 2020. Full-service wedding and event design is the specialty and has driven the schedule since 2022, with daily delivery and floral subscriptions kept on as a sideline.

picks.name: foret design studio
picks.blurb: Forêt is Erin Heath's floral and event design company on Cape Cod. She studied painting and sculpture, built visual displays at Anthropologie, and taught herself floristry, which shows in a studio that sells flowers and styling together.

picks.name: Boston Event Divas
picks.blurb: Boston Event Divas is a full-service wedding planning and floral design company in Peabody that takes a limited number of events each year and pitches its florals to couples on a budget. Day-of coordination and a mobile bar service are offered from the same team.
